question: What is the difference between those two categories?

answer.message:
**Undergraduate level distance education courses offered**: Please indicate at what level(s) your institution does or does not offer distance education courses and/or distance education programs. Check all that apply. Undergraduate level distant education courses Distance education course - A course in which the instructional content is delivered exclusively via distance education. Requirements for coming to campus for orientation, testing, or academic support services do not exclude a course from being classified as distance education.

Source responses: 1 = Yes; 0 = Implied no; -1 = Not reported; -2 = Not applicable

**Undergraduate level distance education programs offered**: Please indicate at what level(s) your institution does or does not offer distance education courses and/or distance education programs. Check all that apply. Undergraduate level distant education progams Distance education program - A program for which all the required coursework for program completion is able to be completed via distance education courses.

Source responses: 1 = Yes; 0 = Implied no; -1 = Not reported; -2 = Not applicable

**Undergraduate level distance education not offered**: Please indicate at what level(s) your institution does or does not offer distance education courses and/or distance education programs. Check all that apply. Undergraduate level distant education not offered Distance education course - A course in which the instructional content is delivered exclusively via distance education. Requirements for coming to campus for orientation, testing, or academic support services do not exclude a course from being classified as distance education. Distance education program - A program for which all the required coursework for program completion is able to be completed via distance education courses.

Source responses: 1 = Yes; 0 = Implied no; -1 = Not reported; -2 = Not applicable

These are distinct source response categories; an unavailable or unreported response must not be interpreted as No.
